Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and TV Leśnik will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in service is shared by everyone using TV Leśnik. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your TV Leśnik backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
TV Leśnik player

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so TV Leśnik finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, TV Leśnik stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, TV Leśnik still falls back to stereo and tells you.

TV Leśnik is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.

Choose an TV Leśnik backup file (.own, or an older .json) and press Send. It is transferred to the TV \u2014 pick up the remote and choose what to restore there.

Your TV has prepared an TV Leśnik backup file. Tap the button to save it to this device (owntv-backup.own). Keep it somewhere safe \u2014 you can restore from it later.
